mapper.select: SELECT icam02_data_id AS data_id, icam02_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_code, icam02_icam_date AS icam_date, icam02_fund_cd AS fund_code, icam02_fund_nm AS fund_name, icam02_asset_cd AS asset_code, icam02_asset_nm AS asset_name, icam02_item_cd AS item_code, icam02_item_nm AS item_name, icam02_seq AS seq, icam02_info_cd AS info_code, icam01_info_nm AS info_name, icam02_tr_cd AS tr_code, icam01_tr_nm AS tr_name, icam02_tgt_date AS tgt_date, icam02_tgt_amt AS tgt_amt, icam02_tgt_std_date AS tgt_std_date, icam02_note AS note, to_char(icam02_create_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS create_date_string, icam02_creater AS creater, icam02_ics_class_tree_id AS ics_class_tree_id, icam02_ics_deadline_id AS ics_deadline_id, icam02_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn, icam02_confirm_person_id AS confirm_person_id FROM icam02_data , icam01_data_info , sys01_company WHERE icam02_icam_company_cd = sys01_icam_company_cd AND icam02_info_cd = icam01_info_cd AND icam02_tr_cd = icam01_tr_cd AND sys01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY icam02_icam_company_cd, icam02_icam_date
